text:
olivia (PM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get firm ETAs for Console GA and Optimize beta? engineering needs dates to lock SDK/webinar calendars.

noah (CTO): high-level: API GA targeted end of May, Console parity mid-June, Optimize beta starting late-June. we'll stagger canaries to reduce blast radius.

olivia (PM): can we call out owners and canary windows (hours/days) so we can put on calendars?

lin (Eng): API owner here. plan: canary 48h (2% -> 10% if green) then 7-day monitoring window before GA. quick deploy snippet: ```ci/deploy --svc api --ver 2.3.1 --canary --pct 2``` smoke tests and metrics dashboard: /dashboards/api-canary.

jess (DevEx): SDK note: please avoid any call-signature changes for the GA path. if there's a new optional param for Optimize, we'll ship it as a minor bump and add migration notes. doc-freeze proposal: API GA - 72 hours.

ravi (Product): Console owner: ravi; UX work + feature parity checklist due by Jun 10. Console canary = 72h after parity branch merged. Security signoff must be complete before GA.

security-bot: Security checklist created: https://internal/checklists/console-security (assignee: julia).

julia (Security): got it. will have privacy/hardening + telemetry opt-out for Optimize by Jun 8. note: for Private deploys default telemetry must be off; add explicit opt-in flow.

olivia (PM): perfect — summary for timeline: API canary late-May -> GA after 7-day watch; Console parity by Jun 10 -> canary mid-June; Optimize beta rolling late-June with telemetry opt-outs. I'll update the roadmap doc and send calendar invites to owners.

noah (CTO): thanks — add an incident postmortem link to each canary ticket so we can capture learnings.

jess (DevEx): will prep SDK changelog + short "what's changing" webinar; scheduling next Wed 11am PT.

olivia (PM): thanks everyone, will follow up here with links to tickets + invites.
